summary: Fixed syntax errors (return outside function) in archimedean.py and sandbox onewaygls.py, reconstructed distributions/discrete.py (all 79 tests in distributions/tests pass), and added copula sampling, tau, independence and elliptical cdf/pdf, a None-seed FutureWarning, and an AIC k_extra fix in base/model.py. Not complete: about 60 copula tests still fail (Pickands functions for negative-logistic, mixed, t-EV and bilogistic, multivariate Archimedean pdf), discrete/test_discrete.py has many failures (base fit_regularized missing), and I never ran the full suite so no full-suite result was recorded.
